lines.text: It made this really loud crack during the bad landing. Its 2 batteries probably flew out.
Leon really loves this drone... The man will kill me for sure...
It probably crashed at a pretty high place — I looked around the place and found nothing at ground level...
Ugh... blight this friggin' blight...
Oh, hi. I'm Rorke. I'm a scientist doing some environment monitoring work in this area... I borrowed a drone from my colleague, Leon. Planned on using it to gather some high altitude data...
But I suck at flying drones and I think its wing hit something before it ... landed badly.
Ugh. I should have listened to Leon. He told me to be careful and warned me that the drone is pretty old and a little hard to control...
By the way, try looking for the drone's batteries. There are two of them.

options: Got it. I'll look for the drone.

r: Got it. I'll look for the drone.

lines.text: Endmin! How goes your search? Did you find the drone?
It probably crashed at a pretty high place — I looked around the place and found nothing at ground level...
Thanks a lot. And don't forget the batteries.
The drone is an old UWST model... Leon used it for years. The dude likes old stuff and treats the drone like family. Even gave it a custom paint job, you know.
He also told me that his UWST drone is clunkier than the latest Endfield models, and told me to be careful with the controls.
I ignored his advice and ... yeah ... crashed his drone on my first try. I'm going to be so dead...

options: Can you tell me where the drone crashed?
Sure. I'll look around some more.

r: Can you tell me where the drone crashed?
Sure. I'll look around some more.

lines.text: Oh! Thank you so much...! WOW! The drone actually survived the crash! The thing probably can still fly!
Yeah. UW designs focus on durability and resilience. But the ergonomics and controls, well...
Thank Talos the drone is alright. I should give it back to Leon ASAP.
Here! Please take this! Token of my sincere appreciation!
By Talos! You found them all! I knew I got super lucky when I ran into you.

options: UWST machines are built to last.

r: UWST machines are built to last.

lines.text: These patrols are wearing me out. Things would be so much easier with drones.
I'm applying for my own drone once this is over. Gotta get my hands on that latest Endfield model!
